  "outcome_blind_selection_assessment": "PASS. The contract fixes the eight pools by the predeclared lexicographic-path rule before reading mixed/rescue/outcome fields, and the runner only revalidates the eight contract-bound paths, task ids, and SHAs. The Pilot reads historical E0 pools only, does not inspect E1 held-out future-skill outcomes, and does not use learned-skill quality to select pools, model, or renderer.",
  "win_clone_identity_assessment": "PASS. Before any provider call, the runner renders one winner BlindedEvidenceUnit list and one winner StreamProjection once, then passes the same object pair to both win_a and win_b. The evidence units are SHA-bound, the initial skill SHA is revalidated, and the summary records the pre-provider evidence bundle as byte-identical. Later hosted prompt drift is not treated as pre-call treatment drift and remains part of the runtime negative-control measurement.",
  "arm_blinding_assessment": "PASS. The V3.1 path places only BlindedEvidenceUnit.evidence_text in the first-party add-record messages field, while projection, rollout, path, provider, and provenance fields remain receipt/database metadata. The updater score is unit.source_score, the selected evidence trajectory score, not pool.acting_success. The runner also hard-checks the rendered evidence for forbidden visible markers.",
  "token_parity_assessment": "PASS. The runner uses ExactMatchedEvidenceBlockRenderer, which enforces tiktoken 0.11.0 cl100k_base, searches actual final re-tokenized WIN/MRW lengths without padding, and the runner requires exact equality for every pool. Nonmixed pools require byte-identical WIN and MRW blocks. transcript_max_chars=100000 is explicitly checked as nonbinding before update execution.",
  "updater_semantics_assessment": "PASS. The Pilot invokes the real first-party MindMemOS SkillEvolver from the pinned commit with batch exactly 8, temperature 0, provider retry 0, thinking disabled, and max_parse_attempts=1. It measures calls, tokens, wall time, parse errors, receipts, and artifact integrity only; it performs no learned-skill quality comparison.",
  "provider_budget_assessment": "PASS. The adapter claims from the shared SQLite ProviderBudgetLedger before provider I/O, and the ledger enforces 10 per arm and 30 total transactionally with contract and authorization binding. Claims are never released after errors or crashes, receipts carry claim ids and counters, and the runner requires receipt/claim/provider-call counts to match. Parse correction is capped at one attempt, and poll recovery reuses the same pre-I/O claim rather than bypassing the ceiling.",
  "checkpoint_resume_assessment": "PASS. Completed arms are content-addressed, verified, and appended to completed_arms.jsonl immediately. Resume revalidates receipt and skill SHAs plus contract, authorization, and causal-purity mode. If an incomplete arm directory contains provider-call artifacts without a completed manifest, the runner raises and stops instead of rerunning that arm.",
  "runtime_and_model_identity_assessment": "PASS. The Pilot must itself run under the exact frozen venv Python, revalidates the freeze and runtime qualification artifacts, checks all bound code SHAs, verifies the MindMemOS commit and clean checkout, revalidates all selected pool and trajectory SHAs, and binds the fresh DeepSeek resolved identity deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813 before provider calls.",
  "scientific_boundary_assessment": "PASS. The contract and runner authorize only runtime/measurability qualification: zero new actor rollouts, zero E1 held-out evaluation, zero learned-skill quality comparison, and zero method-effect GO/HOLD/STOP. A PASS can only support minting a separate SHA-bound provider-runtime Pilot authorization; it does not authorize E1-B, paper claims, frontend promotion, or submission.",

review.arm_blinding_assessment: PASS. The V3.1 path places only BlindedEvidenceUnit.evidence_text in the first-party add-record messages field, while projection, rollout, path, provider, and provenance fields remain receipt/database metadata. The updater score is unit.source_score, the selected evidence trajectory score, not pool.acting_success. The runner also hard-checks the rendered evidence for forbidden visible markers.
review.checkpoint_resume_assessment: PASS. Completed arms are content-addressed, verified, and appended to completed_arms.jsonl immediately. Resume revalidates receipt and skill SHAs plus contract, authorization, and causal-purity mode. If an incomplete arm directory contains provider-call artifacts without a completed manifest, the runner raises and stops instead of rerunning that arm.
nonblocking_notes: The runner contains a tautological self-comparison of the winner evidence bundle SHA; this is harmless because both WIN-A and WIN-B receive the same pre-rendered unit list object, but a future revision could replace it with a stronger explicit recorded-bundle check.

The draft contract status remains DRAFT_PENDING_DUAL_PREEXECUTION_REVIEW, so execution still requires a separately minted frozen contract and authorization exactly matching the reviewed SHA-bound scope.
review.outcome_blind_selection_assessment: PASS. The contract fixes the eight pools by the predeclared lexicographic-path rule before reading mixed/rescue/outcome fields, and the runner only revalidates the eight contract-bound paths, task ids, and SHAs. The Pilot reads historical E0 pools only, does not inspect E1 held-out future-skill outcomes, and does not use learned-skill quality to select pools, model, or renderer.
review.provider_budget_assessment: PASS. The adapter claims from the shared SQLite ProviderBudgetLedger before provider I/O, and the ledger enforces 10 per arm and 30 total transactionally with contract and authorization binding. Claims are never released after errors or crashes, receipts carry claim ids and counters, and the runner requires receipt/claim/provider-call counts to match. Parse correction is capped at one attempt, and poll recovery reuses the same pre-I/O claim rather than bypassing the ceiling.
review.runtime_and_model_identity_assessment: PASS. The Pilot must itself run under the exact frozen venv Python, revalidates the freeze and runtime qualification artifacts, checks all bound code SHAs, verifies the MindMemOS commit and clean checkout, revalidates all selected pool and trajectory SHAs, and binds the fresh DeepSeek resolved identity deepseek-v4-pro-ga-260813 before provider calls.
review.scientific_boundary_assessment: PASS. The contract and runner authorize only runtime/measurability qualification: zero new actor rollouts, zero E1 held-out evaluation, zero learned-skill quality comparison, and zero method-effect GO/HOLD/STOP. A PASS can only support minting a separate SHA-bound provider-runtime Pilot authorization; it does not authorize E1-B, paper claims, frontend promotion, or submission.
review.single_sentence_verdict: The reviewed V3.1 provider-runtime Pilot is outcome-blind, arm-blinded, budgeted, checkpoint-safe, and runtime/measurability-only, so it may proceed only under a separate frozen provider-runtime authorization while E1-B remains on HOLD.
review.token_parity_assessment: PASS. The runner uses ExactMatchedEvidenceBlockRenderer, which enforces tiktoken 0.11.0 cl100k_base, searches actual final re-tokenized WIN/MRW lengths without padding, and the runner requires exact equality for every pool. Nonmixed pools require byte-identical WIN and MRW blocks. transcript_max_chars=100000 is explicitly checked as nonbinding before update execution.
review.updater_semantics_assessment: PASS. The Pilot invokes the real first-party MindMemOS SkillEvolver from the pinned commit with batch exactly 8, temperature 0, provider retry 0, thinking disabled, and max_parse_attempts=1. It measures calls, tokens, wall time, parse errors, receipts, and artifact integrity only; it performs no learned-skill quality comparison.
review.win_clone_identity_assessment: PASS. Before any provider call, the runner renders one winner BlindedEvidenceUnit list and one winner StreamProjection once, then passes the same object pair to both win_a and win_b. The evidence units are SHA-bound, the initial skill SHA is revalidated, and the summary records the pre-provider evidence bundle as byte-identical. Later hosted prompt drift is not treated as pre-call treatment drift and remains part of the runtime negative-control measurement.
